search_policy: Primary sources only; no plot digitization; numeric reuse requires every M1 metadata field.

reviewed_sources.useful_evidence: Simulation and measured-response figures; mentions approximately 5 ms gating and separate 50 cm / 100 ms and ungated checks.
reviewed_sources.reason: No reusable numeric arrays, no complete driver model, calibration/stimulus/environment metadata incomplete, and the author explicitly states that no detailed compression-driver model was attempted.

reviewed_sources.useful_evidence: Licensed geometry description, simulation report/polar images, and links to practical measurements.
reviewed_sources.reason: The page exposes images rather than numeric simulation/measurement arrays; linked measurements use varying third-party drivers/setups and do not provide the complete frozen metadata contract.

reviewed_sources.useful_evidence: Predicted polar maps and raw measurement figures for named compression drivers.
reviewed_sources.reason: No downloadable numeric values, exact tested adapter/model revision and full measurement origin/distance/calibration/gating metadata are not all available.

reviewed_sources.source: R&D Team AKABAK Studies and example projects
reviewed_sources.useful_evidence: Official projects and presentations include simulation-versus-measurement examples such as Bogart, SP38, ABEC21 Sealed and Horn H400.
reviewed_sources.reason: The installed project set contains model projects but no reusable CSV/FRD/ZMA measurement arrays for these cases with the complete measurement contract required by M1.

reviewed_sources.useful_evidence: Primary paper comparing a modeled compression driver under different loads to measurements.
reviewed_sources.reason: The publication page/PDF provides comparison figures but no machine-readable supplementary measurement data and no complete modern WUT/ATH horn geometry mapping.

installed_example_provenance.note: Read-only inspection of the already installed official example package; no tool installation/update and no external files copied into the repository.

decision: No numeric comparison was performed. The Phase-3 report's frozen measurement protocol is the required handoff for a future suitable data package.
